notes: Managed by CMG Leasing. The 1309 Lynn Drive and 509-R Sunridge Drive lines appear on the same page but are probably other CMG rentals, not Chasewood units. The page has a 'Load more' link, so more floor plans may exist. Pet Policy and Lease PDFs were not parsed. A search snippet from a listing site mentioned a $25 application fee, $15/mo pet rent, and a $200 pet fee plus $200 pet deposit, but no fetched page contained that, so it was NOT kept. uHomes showed 'US$1,182 /month' with its own 'No Service Fee' and 'No Deposit' marketing.
